versions.changelog:
Huawei Cloud CCE AZ Power Outage Chaos Experiment — Initial Release

- Provides an end-to-end workflow for simulating an AZ-level power outage in Huawei Cloud CCE clusters.
- Assists users interactively with cluster and AZ selection, environment verification, and compatibility validation.
- Guides through experiment preparation, execution (node shutdown and recovery), monitoring, and log analysis/reporting.
- Includes scripts for automated environment checks, resource discovery, validation, execution, rollback, and reporting.
- Ensures user safety by clearly marking interactive steps and critical validation gates before executing destructive actions.
